loader_conventions.bars: Nautilus 15-MINUTE-LAST-EXTERNAL parquet; ts_event = bar close boundary minus ~1ms (Binance close-time convention); a bar is completed at t iff ts_event <= t (V11 loader rule); inventory snaps closes forward to the UTC slot boundary (research.v12.data_contract.snap_bar_closes_to_slots)
loader_conventions.funding: native exchange settlements (fundingTime, ms, few-ms jitter); PIT applicability: settlement ts within [ts_opened, ts_closed] (research.v12.load_validation.validate_funding_applicability)
loader_conventions.oi: consolidated daily last-5m rows, one row per present day (create_time)
